items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is a bijection identifying morphisms from X with triples of morphisms from the modification X', the completion X_{/T}, and their common completion (source lines 6637-6717, label proposition-glue-modification). The solver must run an etale-descent reduction, prove the equality over the self fibre product by the gluing lemma, then build the glued morphism through infinitesimal neighbourhoods and the coequalizer system of the pushouts theory, closing with essential constancy; the assembly of the colimit system is a research-level argument, not a standard citation. Allowed background: the completion formalism and the cited pushouts lemmas, delivered as navigation pointers.
